notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30838247/6aca611977164f76ac7407af6b4151a181f2ada4.png[/img]
[h2]Hello Stone Ragers! [/h2]
We have been out on Early-Access since August 29th now and we have added quite a lot of content over the last few months and with this big patch we are introducing our USP to the game. Which is the summoning of animals via totems and being able to control and play as deadly creatures such as the saber-toothed tiger or the mighty mammoth. What do you need in order to play an animal in the world of Stone Rage? 

First of all you'll need to set foot into the world and perhaps build your shelter somewhere safe from intruders. Craft your totems and stone circles and place them close to each other and then gather the needed ingredients to summon an animal and to shape-shift into the beast. We have added several abilities and game balance preventions tied to stamina to prevent overpowered animals. You're not invincible while playing as an animal! You can still die so make sure to defend yourself beforehand. Playing as animal tied to a certain time limit. If that expires, your animal will disappear and you return to your human form. You can break the link early. In this case, your animal will enter a sleep state and you can control your human character.If your animal is dead, you will have to summon a new animal and add new ingredients to the totem again. As for the female human character. We'll add her with our next upcoming patch! She needed some more polish.

This is our first introduction of our playable animals. Expect a lot more in the future updates. We heavily rely on players feedback and we would like to ask you to give us feedback on our discord channels so we continue to fix and improve our systems! Also by sharing the word about Stone Rage you tremendously help us out and the development.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30838247/4ddab7d813fdbc493dd4b08a474d082a3facf69c.png[/img]
[h1]Hello, Stone Ragers![/h1]

With Halloween right around the corner, we’re happy to announce another big content patch! We’ve been toiling away this month on bug fixes and new features that we can’t wait to get your feedback on.

While October has been heavily focused on Halloween content, finetuning our crafting system, and our new repair system, November will be all about animals! This will include implementing the core work necessary for playing as animals. We'll also be adding more diversity to spawned animals who will roam and live in the world of Stone Rage. 

We have a lot planned to keep players engaged as we add even more features. The performance of Stone Rage has been great with reliable framerates and stable servers, now it's time to add content and make the game more unique in its own way. Head over to our [url=https://trello.com/b/0nQwap7Y/stone-rage-goals-milestones]roadmap and milestones[/url] to check out what we have planned for you in the coming months. 

As always, we love to hear your suggestions and thoughts. Scroll down to the bottom to learn how to engage with us more! If you like what you see, help us get the word out. Everything helps!

To celebrate the new and upcoming changes, we will be hosting a key giveaway from now until mid-November! 50 keys will be handed out to members on our Discord.  Come on over, enter to win, and stick around to find out how to join our QA-testers.  Our dedicated QA-testers get the first crack at features in early-builds of the game.

notes.title: April Update - Pre-Alpha Playtesting has started!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GL0X4cR.png[/img]

Hello fans and followers, here's Marco, Project Lead of Stone Rage. YES, we are alive! The last few weeks and months have been quite busy for us. We have been working on and off on the project and completely reworked our entire coding foundation (as mentioned in earlier update posts). Our game now runs better than ever due to our reworking. The rework was a much needed step in order to deliver smooth and fluent gameplay experiences for you. Instead of releasing the game in a buggy and laggy state we decided to make sure it runs great before giving it into players hands (however it still could be laggy on your end - we are still testing and fixing). 

[b]What's the next step now?[/b] We have officially started early alpha playtesting with our community on discord. If you want to be part of our tester team, follow the guideline below, and contact us with why you would be a good fit to test our game. Help us find crashes, bugs and add your personal wishes for "Stone Rage".  We have around 50 steam keys to give away! Join us!
[u]
[b]How to join us as an early playtester:[/b][/u]
[olist][*] Make sure you have wishlisted our game on steam
[*] Join our discord channel: [url=https://discord.gg/4HBXU7k]https://discord.gg/4HBXU7k[/url]
[*] Message us in the #game-discussion channel regarding a steam key and why you would be a good fit to help test.
[/olist]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/coTxj7a.png[/img]
Before release on EA:
[list][*] Daily test sessions until mid of May 2020
[*] Fixing all current bugs and crashes from current playsessions (top priority)
[*] Continuing to add more features and systems as we go
[*] On May 17th we'll see how far we've gotten with the games progress and discuss a potential release date on early access
[/list]

During early access
[list][*] entire rework of character model (female & male) + new anim set
[*] addition of the neanderthal race
[*] playability of animals through totems
[*] more map variations + more islands
[*] vehicle system (boats, rafts)
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ulljnN9.png[/img]

[b]Inventory System[/b]
Fully fleshed out inventory system with tons of systems and hidden features. The inventory system is by far the biggest system in our game. We have different item-related features such as splitting, placing, merging, and dropping out items from your inventory. Clothing equipment, construction, crafting, teaming (tribe, to be added later) is heavily tied into the inventory system. 

[b]Farming and Harvesting[/b]
Our harvest system works with either instant pickups, harvesting via timer and farming with tools is the most effective resulting in biggest drop of materials. During Early Access we are going to think about adding in different material-based tools such as flint tools next to stone tools. Each with different advantages and disadvantages. 

[b]Crafting System[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30838247/23ff072611765cbba1306b16287ebab5d7877d90.gif[/img]

[b] Modular Construction System[/b]
[list][*] Placement
[*] Stability System
[*] Interactables (Campfire, Oven, DryingRack, etc.)
[*] Storage Containers
[*] Owner System
[*] Upgrade System (Twig, Wood, Stone, Clay)

Clay (Highest-Tier)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30838247/190488f393418940496ef7293e9b68cb95728f2c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30838247/06656b15b344d8de3c44d31c9ea0c6979fdc9e4f.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[b]Footstep System & Impact System[/b]
Walking on different surface types and materials give different sounds as well as varying visual effects and decals depending on the terrain or material you walk on. Hitting different material-based items also show different impact marks. An already complex system where we can later go crazy with. 
Example: flint tools giving different impacts than stone tools.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30838247/d44f849f69ac04746516d53b20850f6ad8476075.gif[/img]

[b]Tier 2 Cooking: Custom Recipes[/b]
In StoneRage you can either consume raw foods like vegetables and fruits, or you can use our complex tier cooking mechanic where you can cook different types of meat combined with other ingredients such as leaves, roots, or berries together to result in different stat boosts or overall bigger food consumption. This system will be worked on more and more during Early Access. 
Adding in lots of different food recipes for our Tier 2 Cooking System.

[b]Humanoid & Neanderthal Weapons[/b]
All human weapons are finalized and ingame, some of which will be reworked and polished later during Early Access. Neanderthal weapons are in the works.

notes.title: September Update! Accepting donations for development
notes.notes:
Hello fans and followers, here's Marco Muellner, Project Lead of Stone Rage. Unfortunately our Community Manager Zac Knapp had to leave us, that's why I'm writting this update myself to give everyone heads up on where we are at with our development at the moment. First of all I'd like to apologize for our very little communication on our steam forums the last weeks and months. It has been quiet and rough here at the indie studio Mountainwheel Games, as we were trying to find a good, reliable programmer who can help us with the two biggest and most important game features, such as construction and AI animals. But, the good news is, we have found one talented programmer (Kenny) already. We are looking for more programmers to join us and then we are set and ready to start more testing sessions with all our new features and assets. If you are a talented programmer and are interested in working with us on Stone Rage, check the bottom of our update text for contact details!

[b]Update on AI & Construction:[/b]
Our newest programmer Kenny has started work on the AI for animals. He has started out with an AI animal spawner which basically spawns animals all around the map with different parameters telling when, where and under what conditions animals spawn. Depending on where you are at on the huge map, animals will have different spawn rates and not all animals will be seen in every biome. AI is quite complex and needs tons of love to work properly. After that we are starting work on all of our animal blueprint classes and then we are finishing up the construction system. A lot more work needed to finish all of this. Here are some renderings from Pedro with the latest construction stuff.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fy9ddsC.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/so4gpi5.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kqzv3Nj.jpg[/img]

[b]Goals and Milestones:[/b]
Our goals and milestones within the following weeks will be to finish AI, construction system, rework our website, updating our gamepedia wiki, hiring a new community manager and getting our foundation set for more testing with our discord community! Stay tuned!

[b]Donations:[/b]
Next up, from this day on we are accepting donations from everyone who wants to support us and the development of Stone Rage on PayPal. All the funds will directly go to the developers who are working extremly hard on Stone Rage. This will tremendously help with putting more time into the game since we all have fulltime jobs next to Stone Rage (hopefully soon Stone Rage will become our fulltime position). That's our huge goal and we are working towards it. But it's not easy especially as an unfunded indie studio since day one. Every penny helps! Thank you!

https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_s-xclick&hosted_button_id=PUDNY2QKCPBEQ&source=url

If you are interested, here is the link to our Discord channel: https://discord.gg/Ew5PdWt

[b]Hiring:[/b]
If you'd like to work with us on Stone Rage, do not hesitate to send us an email to our project lead Marco and write all the details about yourself why you are the right fit. [/b]Email:[/b] marco@stoneragegame.com


All the best,
Thank you for all your support and love!
Marco Muellner, Project Lead Stone Rage

notes.title: April Update
notes.notes:
Happy April everyone!
Just a quick post from us today as we remain hard at work getting everything ready for testing. We are still making constant changes and fixes but progress is coming along smoothly. In the meantime, we wanted to give you a little progress update and let you all know what we are working on besides basic polish.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/m0UEmyx.jpg[/img]

While our programmer keeps hid his head buried in his keyboard cranking out fixes, our designers are coming up with some new in game gear. We have some new clothing and armor in the works that will allow you to up your game and bring an extended level of customization to your prehistoric humanoid of choice. These new pieces are looking great and draw some inspiration from other ancient civilizations, as you can see in the concept art. We will be including different, unique pieces of clothing that can be crafted from the materials of animals you encounter, kill and skin. Now you can show the world that you took down the mighty mammoth. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/89Avlln.jpg[/img]

I would also like to remind you all of our plans for an upcoming period of testing. As always, stay tuned for more information. Join our discord with the link below for an opportunity to chat with the team and continue to stay in the loop.

 https://discord.gg/pbz4AqP
